role: One entry per tracked entity: converts the entity's position/rotation/motion into the S13/S14/S15/S16/S17/S18/S19/S12 packet stream every updateFrequency ticks, sends the spawn packet to players entering range and removes those leaving it.

members.name: myEntity
members.note: the entry keeps the entity id, a handle (the GPU contract: no entity addresses across ticks)

members.name: field_85178_v
members.note: the ridden vehicle as its id (riding_entity); a changed vehicle or every 60th update riding sends the S1B

members.name: trackingPlayers
members.note: the one player of the game: the watched flag is the set's membership

members.name: equals
members.note: id equality; the native array lookup is by id

members.name: sendLocationToAllClients
members.note: S15/S16/S17/S18/S12/S19 emission with the 4-tick thresholds, the 60-tick sync and the 400-tick forced teleport

members.name: func_111190_b
members.note: the S1C metadata packet; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: informAllAssociatedPlayersOfItemDestruction
members.note: the S13 on removal; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: tryStartWachingThis
members.note: the previous-position range check, the chunk-watch gate and the S0F spawn; a leash knot's forceSpawn passes the chunk gate (pickobj.c try_watch), so the respawn's trackEntity loop sends it in the respawn's own queue (pickobj_server_respawned; a dimension-changing respawn builds it in the new world: pfc-knotrespawn-f55); a dead item not yet removed keeps its entry, and a chunk sent before its removal spawns it (pickobj_chunk_sent, pfc-deaditem-g4)

members.name: isPlayerWatchingThisChunk
members.note: cl_player_watching: the player manager's instance holds the player and the chunk has been sent (off loadedChunks)

members.name: sendEventsToPlayers
members.note: a loop over the packet list

members.name: func_151260_c
members.note: the spawn packet by class: S0F for livings with their watcher (combat.c), S0E for items (their stack), arrows, thrown items, eyes, TNT, falling blocks, fireballs (the shooter and the acceleration, combat.c track_fireball), crystals, knots; S10 paintings, S0E frames with their S1C; S11 orbs; the dragon's S0F

notes: The tracker's tick output is a struct tracker_packet stream consumed by clientworld.c's clientworld_handle_packet, which keeps the client-side half of the loop in lockstep. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): only observable by a second player; the env is single player; the renderer reads server state for metadata.
